verdict.rationale: Ardent documents some deletion controls: agents can create and delete their own branches via the CLI, and the API offers a deletion-lock endpoint that blocks connector deletes until unlocked. It also states that actual data never leaves the data plane and that preflight stores no credentials. There is no evidence of configurable retention policies or of controlling how long Ardent keeps data. Missing for 10: retention policies/TTL or auto-expiry for branches, documented account/org-level data deletion and purge guarantees, control over retention of control-plane metadata, independent corroboration.
